steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Vikunja at http://127.0.0.1:8096/ using username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the signed-in app is open and report the resulting page.
02-report: In the Bench Project project, identify and report the exact titles of every task whose title starts with 'Seed:'. Do not edit any tasks.

03-create: In Bench Project, create a task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' with a description that includes the exact runid '{{runid}}'. Submit it, then verify the task exists and report its displayed title and identifier from its page.
04-set: On the page for '{{runid}} Bench Task' in Bench Project, set its due date to 2026-12-31. Ensure it is saved and report the exact due date displayed on the task page.
05-set: On the page for '{{runid}} Bench Task' ({{03-create.task_identifier}}), set its priority to High and verify the task page displays High after saving or reloading.

06-verify: On '{{runid}} Bench Task' ({{03-create.task_identifier}}), attach the existing Backend label by selecting it from the label suggestions, not by creating a new label. Verify the task page shows the Backend label after saving or reload.

07-add: On the page for '{{runid}} Bench Task' ({{03-create.task_identifier}}), add a comment whose text includes the exact runid '{{runid}}'. Submit the comment and verify the submitted comment is visible on the task page; also report its exact text.
